name: trakt
description: Browse Trakt's catalog of movies and shows, and manage your Trakt watchlist, watch history, collection, ratings, smart lists, check-ins and recommendations from ChatGPT or Codex. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in through your Trakt account.

com.openai.interface.shortDescription: Manage what you watch on Trakt
com.openai.interface.longDescription: Ask your assistant what is trending, look up a show or movie, its cast, ratings and comments, see which episode comes next, add titles to your watchlist or collection, mark episodes as watched, rate what you saw, browse your smart lists and custom lists, see calendars and where to watch, keep notes and favorites, check in to what you are watching, or tune your recommendations. You sign in with your Trakt account. Viewing data is read and written live through the Trakt API and is never stored on the server. Every tool that changes your Trakt account says so in its description, and removal tools are flagged as destructive. Independent open source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
defaultPrompt: What are the trending shows this week?
What is the next episode of Severance I should watch?
Add Dune: Part Two to my Trakt watchlist.
